title_en: Zuo Chenghong, Li Yongtai, Xie Lin, and Wu Zijun — case of causing death and injury by dangerous methods of manufacturing and selling toxic alcohol
keywords_en: criminal; crime of endangering public security; second instance; High People's Court; Sichuan Province; natural person; Criminal Law; whether the sentence is appropriate; determination of principal offender; reversal; manufacturing toxic alcohol; selling toxic alcohol; causing casualties; blending liquor with industrial alcohol
full_text_en:
Zuo Chenghong, Li Yongtai, Xie Lin, and Wu Zijun — Case of Causing Casualties by Dangerous Method of Manufacturing and Selling Toxic Liquor

Defendant: Zuo Chenghong, male, 32 years old, formerly the contractor of the Chengdu Bulk Liquor Wholesale Department of Dayi County Erqing Industrial Supply and Marketing Company of Sichuan Province.

Defendant: Li Yongtai, male, 41 years old, formerly a salesman at the Chengdu Caotang Bulk Liquor Sales Point of Dayi County Erqing Industrial Supply and Marketing Company of Sichuan Province.

Defendant: Xie Lin, male, 28 years old, formerly the manager of the Taikang Hardware, Electrical, and Chemical Products Store under the Baijiatang Subdistrict Office of Xicheng District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province.

Defendant: Wu Zijun, male, 54 years old, formerly the manager of Dayi County Erqing Industrial Supply and Marketing Company of Sichuan Province.

Without approval from the administrative department of industry and commerce or the health department, Dayi County Erqing Industrial Supply and Marketing Company established a liquor wholesale department in Chengdu in October 1983. Defendant Wu Zijun, through personal connections, hired defendant Zuo Chenghong as a salesman for that wholesale department. In March 1985, Zuo Chenghong signed a contract with Wu Zijun, under which Zuo Chenghong contracted the wholesale department's liquor business. During the contract negotiation process, Zuo told Wu that he intended to use alcohol to concoct and sell liquor. Although Wu knew that Zuo had neither equipment nor testing methods, and only heard Zuo say that the alcohol was purchased from the Dayi County Township and Village Enterprise Bureau, which sold edible alcohol, Wu stated that as long as Zuo paid RMB 800 each month, he could do whatever he wanted. After the contract was signed, Zuo Chenghong jointly operated with defendant Li Yongtai, and with Wu Zijun's approval, Li Yongtai was hired as a salesman for the company's liquor wholesale department in Chengdu.

From March to May 1985, Zuo Chenghong and Li Yongtai successively purchased over 20 tons of edible alcohol from the chemical plant of the Dayi County Township and Village Enterprise Bureau, illegally concocted and sold "white liquor" and "aged liquor" for profit. In April 1985, Zuo Chenghong told Li Yongtai that the edible alcohol from the chemical plant of the Dayi County Township and Village Enterprise Bureau was running low and had increased in price. Li then suggested that everyone help find alcohol. Subsequently, Li asked defendant Xie Lin to help purchase alcohol. Xie Lin successively contacted a store of Fenghuangshan Chemical Plant and the Jinniu District Construction and Auxiliary Materials Business Department of Chengdu City to buy alcohol, and took Zuo Chenghong and Li Yongtai to see samples at the Chengdu Chenguang Chemical Shop. Sales personnel from all three units clearly told them that what they were selling was industrial alcohol. Ultimately, after Zuo and Li confirmed, Zuo decided to purchase the industrial alcohol sold by the Construction and Auxiliary Materials Business Department. On May 11 and June 2, 1985, Xie Lin twice purchased 35 barrels (5,600 kg) of industrial alcohol from that business department, transporting 23 barrels (3,680 kg) to Zuo Chenghong's sales point and 12 barrels (1,920 kg) to Li Yongtai's sales point. From mid-May to early June, Zuo Chenghong and Li Yongtai used a total of 4,160 jin of industrial alcohol (1 jin = 0.5 kg), added water to concoct over 780 jin of "white liquor," sold over 1,300 jin, causing more than 20 people to suffer methanol poisoning after drinking it, resulting in 15 deaths and 7 cases of disability. Due to the timely investigation and case solving by the health and anti-epidemic departments and public security organs, the remaining industrial alcohol, the "white liquor" already concocted but not yet sold, and the "white liquor" already sold but not yet consumed were all sealed and prohibited from use, thus avoiding even more severe harmful consequences. During the investigation, Li Yongtai and Xie Lin moved and concealed the unused industrial alcohol.

On August 3, 1985, the Chengdu People's Procuratorate of Sichuan Province filed a public prosecution in accordance with the law. On August 13, the Chengdu Intermediate People's Court of Sichuan Province rendered a judgment, finding that defendants Zuo Chenghong, Li Yongtai, and Xie Lin, knowing that consuming "white liquor" concocted from industrial alcohol would harm human health, nonetheless purchased large quantities of industrial alcohol, concocted and sold "white liquor" for exorbitant profits, causing severe consequences, thus constituting the crime of causing casualties by dangerous method of manufacturing and selling toxic liquor. Zuo Chenghong, Li Yongtai, and Xie Lin were all principals in this case. Defendant Wu Zijun, as the manager of Dayi County Erqing Industrial Supply and Marketing Company, failed to fulfill his leadership and supervisory duties with respect to Zuo Chenghong and Li Yongtai's use of industrial alcohol to concoct and sell liquor, and failed to timely detect and stop it, thereby causing severe harmful consequences, thus constituting the crime of dereliction of duty. Pursuant to Article 106, paragraph 1 and Article 53, paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law, Zuo Chenghong was sentenced to death, with deprivation of political rights for life; Li Yongtai was sentenced to death, with a two-year suspension of execution, and deprivation of political rights for life; Xie Lin was sentenced to life imprisonment, with deprivation of political rights for life. Pursuant to Article 187 of the Criminal Law, Wu Zijun was sentenced to five years' imprisonment.

After the judgment was pronounced, the Chengdu People's Procuratorate of Sichuan Province considered that the first-instance judgment imposed too light a sentence on defendant Li Yongtai, and that the sentence of death with a two-year suspension of execution was improper, so it filed a protest with the Sichuan High People's Court in accordance with the law. Zuo Chenghong and Wu Zijun each appealed.

In a second-instance judgment on August 26, the Sichuan High People's Court found that the original judgment was accurate in the determination of the crimes and the trial procedure was lawful, and the sentences for defendants Zuo Chenghong, Xie Lin, and Wu Zijun were appropriate. The grounds of appeal of Zuo Chenghong and Wu Zijun were untenable. Defendant Li Yongtai played an active role in the entire criminal process and was one of the primary persons responsible for the severe consequences of 15 deaths and 7 cases of disability. The original judgment imposed an inappropriate sentence on Li Yongtai. The protest by the Chengdu People's Procuratorate of Sichuan Province was well-founded and adopted accordingly. On that basis, pursuant to Article 136, items (1) and (2) of the Criminal Procedure Law, the appeals of Zuo Chenghong and Wu Zijun were dismissed. The first-instance judgment concerning Zuo Chenghong, Xie Lin, and Wu Zijun was affirmed; the portion of the first-instance judgment concerning the punishment of Li Yongtai was reversed, and Li Yongtai was instead sentenced to death, with deprivation of political rights for life.

The Sichuan High People's Court approved the death sentences of Zuo Chenghong and Li Yongtai, with deprivation of political rights for life.
